title: Pure Gishki
summary: Gishki Ritual cards with generic staples, and no Spright or Herald engine. The page's combo lines add Herald, Nephthys and Hieratic cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. Grimness summons another Gishki from the Deck, Shadow and Vision search the Ritual Spells and Monsters and can each pay a whole Ritual Tribute alone, and Neremanas, the newest Ritual, revives a WATER monster and bounces itself to negate effects.
main: Gishki Grimness
Summoned: summons another Gishki from the Deck; can pay a whole WATER Ritual Tribute alone.
Gishki Shadow
Discards to search a Gishki Ritual Spell; can pay a whole WATER Ritual Tribute alone.
Gishki Vision
Discards to search a Gishki Ritual Monster; can pay a whole WATER Ritual Tribute alone.
Gishki Abyss
Summoned: searches a Gishki with 1000 or less DEF.
Gishki Chain
Normal Summoned: digs three cards for a Ritual Monster or Spell.
Gishki Marker
Summoned: returns a Gishki Ritual Monster or Spell from the GY.
Gishki Vanity
Discards so the opponent can't respond to your Gishki Ritual Spell or Ritual Summon.
Evigishki Neremanas
Newest Ritual. Revives a WATER monster on summon, and returns a Gishki Ritual to the hand to negate a monster effect.
Evigishki Gustkraken
Ritual Summoned: looks at two cards in the opponent's hand and shuffles one away.
Evigishki Soul Ogre
Discards a Gishki to shuffle an opposing face-up card into the Deck.
Evigishki Mind Augus
Ritual Summoned: shuffles up to five cards from the GYs into the Deck.
Focused Aquamirror
Searches any Gishki monster; from the GY, Sets another Aquamirror card.
Gishki Aquamirror
Ritual Spell for any Gishki; recycles a Gishki Ritual from the GY.
Gishki Nekromirror
Ritual Spell that can Tribute one opposing face-up monster instead.
extra: Rank 4 that shuffles the monsters it destroys into the Deck.
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
